en.text: Tom finished his coffee and went off to work.

original: やり終えるのに３時間かかったよ。

en.text: It took me three hours to finish doing that.
It took me three hours to finish.
It took me three hours to finish it.

original: 彼はコーヒーを飲み終え、支払いを済ませた。

en.text: He finished his coffee and paid the bill.

original: 一日でこの本を読み終えたんだって。

en.text: He finished reading the book in a single day.
He said he read this book in a day.

original: この手紙書き終えたら、手伝うね。

en.text: I'll help you after I finish this letter.

original: 仕事を終えた後、彼は出かけた。

en.text: After work, he went out.

original: その本を読み終えると、私は本をぎゅっと抱きしめた。

en.text: When I finished reading that book, I hugged it.
